arxiv-1510-04501.title: Towards Cleaning-up Open Data Portals: A Metadata Reconciliation Approach
arxiv-1510-04501.creator: Alan Tygel+, Sören Auer*, Jeremy Debattista*, Fabrizio Orlandi*, Maria Luiza Machado Campos+
arxiv-1510-04501.description: Abstract This paper presents an approach for metadata reconciliation, curation and linking for Open Governamental Data Portals (ODPs). ODPs have been lately the standard solution for governments willing to put their public data available for the society. Portal managers use several types of metadata to organize the datasets, one of the most important ones being the tags.

arxiv-2108-13103.title: Velocity difference of ions and neutrals in solar prominences
arxiv-2108-13103.creator: E. Wiehr, G. Stellmacher, H. Balthasar, and M. Bianda
arxiv-2108-13103.description: Abstract Marked velocity excesses of ions relative to neutrals are obtained from two time series of the neighboring emission lines He i 5015 Å and Fe ii 5018 Å in a quiescent prominence. Their Doppler shifts show time variations of quasi-periodic character where the ions are faster than the neutrals 1.

arxiv-2206-08029.title: DIALOG-22 RuATD Generated Text Detection
arxiv-2206-08029.creator: Narek Maloyan, Bulat Nutfullin, Eugene Ilyushin
arxiv-2206-08029.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Narek Maloyan, Bulat Nutfullin, Eugene Ilyushin. Text Generation Models (TGMs) succeed in creating text that matches human language style reasonably well. Detectors that can distinguish between TGM-generated text and human-written ones play an important role in preventing abuse of TGM. In this paper, we describe our pipeline for the two DIALOG-22 RuATD tasks: detecting generated text (binary task) and classification of which model was used to generate text (multiclass task) [ \citenameShamardina et al.2022a ] .

arxiv-2212-12582.title: Quantum correlation light-field microscope with extreme depth of field
arxiv-2212-12582.creator: Yingwen Zhang, Duncan England, Antony Orth, Ebrahim Karimi, Benjamin Sussman
arxiv-2212-12582.description: Abstract Light-field microscopy (LFM) is a 3D microscopy technique whereby volumetric information of a sample is gained by simultaneously capturing both the position and momentum (angular) information of light illuminating a scene. Conventional LFM designs generally require a trade-off between position and momentum resolution, requiring one to sacrifice resolving power for increased depth of field (DOF) or vice versa.

arxiv-2307-02980.title: Constraint Programming models for the parallel drone scheduling vehicle routing problem
arxiv-2307-02980.creator: Roberto Montemanni, Mauro Dell’Amico
arxiv-2307-02980.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Roberto Montemanni, Mauro Dell’Amico. Drones are currently seen as a viable way for improving the distribution of parcels in urban and rural environments, while working in coordination with traditional vehicles like trucks. In this paper we consider the parallel drone scheduling vehicle routing problem, where the service of a set of customers requiring a delivery is split between a fleet of trucks and a fleet of drones. We consider two variations of the problem.

arxiv-2409-14564.title: event-ECC: Asynchronous Tracking of Events with Continuous Optimization
arxiv-2409-14564.creator: Maria Zafeiri, Georgios Evangelidis, Emmanouil Psarakis, Department of Computer Engineering and Informatics, University of Patras, Greece, {zafeiri, psarakis}@ceid.upatras.gr, Snap Inc, Vienna, Austria
arxiv-2409-14564.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maria Zafeiri, Georgios Evangelidis, Emmanouil Psarakis, Department of Computer Engineering and Informatics, University of Patras, Greece, {zafeiri, psarakis}@ceid.upatras.gr, Snap Inc, Vienna, Austria. In this paper, an event-based tracker is presented. Inspired by recent advances in asynchronous processing of individual events, we develop a direct matching scheme that aligns spatial distributions of events at different times. More specifically, we adopt the Enhanced Correlation Coefficient (ECC) criterion and propose a tracking algorithm that computes a 2D motion warp per single event, called event-ECC (eECC).

arxiv-2412-20538.creator: Qucheng Peng, Ce Zheng, Zhengming Ding, Pu Wang, and Chen Chen Center for Research in Computer Vision, University of Central Florida, Orlando, USA Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, USA Department of Computer Science, Tulane University, New Orleans, USA University of North C
arxiv-2412-20538.description: Abstract Human pose estimation (HPE) has received increasing attention recently due to its wide application in motion analysis, virtual reality, healthcare, etc. However, it suffers from the lack of labeled diverse real-world datasets due to the time- and labor-intensive annotation.

arxiv-2501-12307.title: On finite groups whose order supergraphs satisfy a connectivity condition
arxiv-2501-12307.creator: Ramesh Prasad Panda, Papi Ray
arxiv-2501-12307.description: Abstract Let Γ \Gamma be an undirected and simple graph. A set S S of vertices in Γ \Gamma is called a cyclic vertex cutset of Γ \Gamma if Γ − S \Gamma-S is disconnected and has at least two components containing cycles. If Γ \Gamma has a cyclic vertex cutset, then it is said to be cyclically separable.

arxiv-2505-10859.title: Exploring Nonlinear Pathway in Parameter Space for Machine Unlearning
arxiv-2505-10859.creator: Yingdan Shi, Ren Wang
arxiv-2505-10859.description: Abstract Machine Unlearning (MU) aims to remove the information of specific training data from a trained model, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations and user requests. While one line of existing MU methods relies on linear parameter updates via task arithmetic, they suffer from weight entanglement.

arxiv-2602-19643.title: KGHaluBench: A Knowledge Graph-Based Hallucination Benchmark for Evaluating the Breadth and Depth of LLM Knowledge
arxiv-2602-19643.creator: Alex Robertson, Huizhi Liang, Mahbub Gani, Rohit Kumar, Srijith Rajamohan
arxiv-2602-19643.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) possess a remarkable capacity to generate persuasive and intelligible language. However, coherence does not equate to truthfulness, as the responses often contain subtle hallucinations. Existing benchmarks are constrained by static, narrow questions, resulting in limited coverage and misleading evaluations.

Background/Objectives: The relationship between health-related quality of life (HRQL) in community-dwelling older adults and the consumption of foods typical of the Mediterranean diet (MD) has not been studied. pmc-13305824.title: HEART评分系统在急性冠脉综合征患者中的应用进展
pmc-13305824.creator: 洪圉 赵, 彩云 唐, 应龙 段, 莎 王, 丽群 赵, 美英 郭
pmc-13305824.description: 急性冠脉综合征(acute coronary syndromes，ACS)是临床最危重的心血管急症之一，对患者进行快速识别、精准危险分层与早期干预是改善其预后的核心环节。HEART评分系统由病史(history，H)、心电图(electrocardiogram，E)、年龄(age，A)、危险因素(risk factor，R)、肌钙蛋白(troponin，T)5项核心指标构成，是急诊胸痛患者风险评估与分层管理的重要工具，具备操作简便、评估高效、循证依据充分等特点，已被多国胸痛诊疗指南推荐使用。系统综述HEART评分系统在ACS患者中的应用进展，详细阐述其评分构成、分级标准与急诊应用流程，重点梳理该评分在ACS早期诊断、危险分层、治疗决策与预后评估中的临床价值，并对比分析HEART评分与其他常用评分的适用场景与效能差异，同时指出该评分在动态监测、主观偏倚、特殊人群适用性及本土化应用中存在的局限，进一步对其动态化、智能化、本土化改良方向进行展望，有望为国内急诊与心血管领域更科学、规范、高效地应用HEART评分系统提供参考，助力实现ACS患者的早期筛查、精准分流与优化救治。 急性冠脉综合征(acute coronary syndromes，ACS)是一组由冠状动脉粥样硬化斑块破裂或侵袭继发形成新的血栓从而引发的一系列的临床综合征[1-2]，是缺血性心脏病最危急、最致命的一种形式，严重威胁人类生存与健康[3-4]。胸痛往往是ACS的首发症状，急诊作为鉴别该人群的第一窗口，需要快速准确识别ACS，以加速该人群的早期治疗[5-6]。ACS的早期识别与精准分层救治是临床实践中的关键难题，国际心血管领域已研发出具有循证医学证据的胸痛风险评估工具——HEART评分系统[7]。HEART评分包括病史(history，H)、心电图(electrocardiogram，E)、年龄(age，A)、危险因素(risk factor，R)、肌钙蛋白(troponin，T)5项指标，构建了简明高效的评估框架，其操作简便且耗时短，已被纳入胸痛指南并被收录在临床决策系统中[8-10]。中国已有部分单中心研究[11-12]对HEART评分进行了应用探索，但尚未完成多中心、大样本的本土化验证，也未正式纳入国家级胸痛救治指南。HEART评分虽在国际上广泛应用，但其在中国人群的适用性、特殊人群调整策略及本土化路径尚未系统评估。因此，本文通过整合国内外证据，旨在为临床实践更科学、高效地应用HEART评分系统提供实用参考，助力ACS患者的早期识别、精准分层和优化管理，最终提升诊疗质量与患者预后。 HEART评分系统的构成 HEART评分系统是针对急诊胸痛患者开发的ACS风险预测工具。该系统通过对患者H、E、A、R及T情况分别赋予0~2分，患者的总评分范围为0~10，具体评分标准见表1。HEART评分系统是一种强大、简便且非常实用的工具，能够将患者分为低危、中危和高危组：评分为0~3的患者为低危组，可以离院观察；评分为4~6的患者为中危组，需要进一步留院检查；而评分在7及以上的患者为高危组，需要紧急干预[13]。 H：病史；E：心电图；A：年龄；R：危险因素；T：肌钙蛋白；BMI：体重指数；CVD：心血管疾病；MI：心肌梗死；PCI：经皮冠状动脉介入治疗；CABG：冠状动脉旁路移植术；CVA：心血管意外；TIA：短暂性脑缺血发作；LBBB：左束支传导阻滞；LVH：左室肥厚。 HEART评分系统在ACS患者中的应用现状 在诊断中的应用 在早期诊断中，HEART评分系统能够帮助医师快速判断患者存在ACS的可能性，HEART评分系统的急诊应用流程见图1。多项研究[14-15]表明，对于有胸痛症状的患者，HEART评分较高者患ACS的概率明显增加，HEART评分能够为医师进一步的检查和诊断提供方向。例如，Six等[14]分析了122例因胸痛转诊至急诊室的患者的临床数据，发现HEART评分在预测ACS诊断方面具有较高的敏感度和特异度，能够有效筛选出可能患有ACS的患者。Ke等[15]纳入18项研究(n=36 752)进行荟萃分析发现，HEART评分预测主要不良心血管事件(major adverse cardiovascular events，MACE)的曲线下面积(area under the curve，AUC)为0.89，其低风险组的漏诊率低于1%，安全性高。该研究认为，HEART评分在预测ACS诊断上优于传统评分，推荐将其作为急诊胸痛评估的首选工具。 HEART评分急诊应用流程图 Figure pmc-13582881.title: Compartmentalized biomarker correlations in HIV: plasma-CSF relationships vary by blood-brain/blood-CSF barrier permeability and viral suppression
pmc-13582881.creator: Ronald J Ellis, Bin Tang, Patricia K Riggs, Jennifer E ludicello, Maria Cecilia G Marcondes, Violaine Delorme-Walker, Robert K Heaton, Scott L Letendre
pmc-13582881.description: Neuroinflammation is common in people with HIV (PWH) and may be reflected also in plasma biomarkers; the latter are sometimes used as surrogates for CSF. However, use of plasma biomarkers in this way risks obscuring compartment-specific processes since distribution across the blood–brain barrier (BBB) varies between proteins with some reaching the CNS more readily than others.
